description: Official TJHSST (Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology) admissions facts from FCPS data EduAvenues obtained, including FOIA responses not published elsewhere: admission rates by middle school, class year, gender, race/ethnicity and experience factors (economically disadvantaged, multilingual learners, students with disabilities), average GPA of admitted, waitpooled and rejected applicants, and the 2026-27 application and test dates. Use view "overview" for the big picture and dates, "middle_school" with a school name, or "class_year" with a year (2025-2029). Rates only, each with its source and received date; suppressed groups are marked.

classYear.description: TJ graduating class year for view "class_year"

middleSchool.description: Middle school name for view "middle_school", e.g. "Carson"
